headline: Knicks come back from 13 down to win in overtime
dek: Down 13 in the fourth, the Knicks won in overtime; Jalen Brunson’s corner three put them ahead for good.
three: On his 31st birthday, with a double-double in all 13 games this season.
Knicks down 7 after three, then won overtime 17–13
Towns and Brunson combined for 56 of 112.
